title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): Get early access preview versions as a partner – Early Access Preview (Next Major) environment in Cloud/SaaS
summary: Partners with the Dynamics 365 Business Central Partner Sandbox license can access Early Access Preview (EAP) environments for BC27 before general availability, allowing early testing of new features with an additional sandbox environment quota. This helps partners prepare for the next major version without affecting existing sandbox resources.
key_points: Partner Sandbox license holders get automatic access to Early Access Preview environments for the next major Business Central version
EAP environments provide an extra sandbox quota separate from existing partner sandbox environments
Environments update automatically with weekly builds during development for continuous testing and feedback
EAP is currently available for DE, GB, and US localizations only
Partners need valid MPN ID and at least five employees to qualify for Partner Sandbox license

quotes.text: Tenants with the partner sandbox license automatically get an extra environment quota for a sandbox environment on the early access preview version.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that EAP doesn't consume existing sandbox quotas, making it easier for partners to test without sacrificing development resources

quotes.text: Early previews are available for the DE, GB, and US localizations.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the geographic and localization scope of the EAP offering

quotes.text: Because the Cloud (SaaS) version does not support the Next Major version, partners have had to use Docker.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains why EAP solves a previous pain point for partners developing AppSource apps
